title: Be ready for AI-agent checkout and rising hardware costs this holiday
summary: ChatGPT Wallet lets agents pay at retailer checkouts; Klarna joined Adyen agentic suite (PYMNTS). Tablet shipments fell 23% in Q3 (Omdia); PCB shortage lasts to mid-2028; AI server prices up to 45% (DigiTimes). Walmart US e-commerce +23%.

points.headline: AI agents can now pay, so checkout must be agent-ready
points.detail: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet for agent purchases at retailer checkouts, and Klarna is now in Adyen’s agentic suite. We should test our store checkout and financing for agent-initiated orders.

points.headline: Supply squeeze and weak demand pressure PC pricing and inventory
points.detail: Tablet shipments fell 23% in Q3, notebooks stay weak into Q2 2027, a PCB shortage lasts to mid-2028 and AI server prices are rising up to 45%. We should plan inventory and pricing carefully.

points.headline: Delivery speed and AI assistants are winning share at key retailers
points.detail: Walmart U.S. e-commerce grew 23% in Q3 on fulfillment speed, and Target reports an early sales lift from its AI assistant. Our marketplace delivery promises and guided shopping need to keep pace.

points.headline: Small-business holiday budgets are at a 14-year high
points.detail: Amex projects a 14-year high in small business holiday spending. We should push business bundles, financing and bulk offers to this buyer group.
